## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (75%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged (tier 3) for low reliability and Benign-vs-Normal ambiguity; recut and deeper levels are drafted.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 75%, Normal 24%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Favors Benign; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Normal, Benign} (alpha 10%; 90% test coverage) | Cannot separate Benign from Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 30% (flagged), OOD 98th percentile [F6] | Atypical input; suspect image quality |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models split |
| Similar cases | 1/5 Benign, 4/5 Normal (20% match) [F5] | Nearest neighbors mostly labeled Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Unreliable concept (-0.69 contribution; 0/20 AI spot check) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 4, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.45 contribution; 18/20 spot check; caption mismatch) [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 5, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.42 contribution; 19/20 spot check) [F4] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.83; +0.42 contribution; 12/20 spot check) · Weak
- **Nuclear size and immune fraction** (regions 3, 5, 8) · context · Nuclei 39.8 µm² (0th percentile) [F7]; immune fraction 16% (100th) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test set (deletion drop +0.0114 vs random, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); top driver `normal_lobules` (0/20 spot check) is unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Artifact (98th percentile OOD) skewed embeddings; 4/5 nearest neighbors are Normal (`BACH_0236` at 84% similarity).
- Focal stromal invasion in regions 5 and 11 is real but masked by poor section quality.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 11**: Check for stromal invasion (scores 1.13, 1.01; region 5 risk 0.002); region 11 lacks cell counts.
2. **Regions 3, 5, 8**: Verify 16% immune cells, small nuclei (39.8 µm²), and 96th-percentile dead cells (3%) [F9].
3. **Regions 0, 2, 4, 7, 10**: Distinguish Benign tubules from Normal lobules (unreliable score); consider drafted recut or deeper levels.
